files.insight: Nested loop and unreachable-block simplification regression covers analysis lifetime during deletion. Test source uses undef and inbounds; no equivalent Ink optimization follows from those assumptions.

Two-round forced recursive specialization with null versus stack pointers exercises initialized state after clone iteration. Candidate state must be fully initialized each iteration; fixture alone does not identify the historical field defect.
Avoid cloning for unused arguments or arguments already constant across all known calls. Such cloning adds no new information; argument elimination still needs ordinary effects and equality checks.
When one specialization binds a subset of another, route calls to the appropriate specific signature after ranking; dead argument elimination is a separate downstream pass.

Call rewriting and undef-resolution can change executable reachability; reconsider calls newly exposed after specialization and preserve address-taken originals. LLVM undef/poison/nontermination are not Ink equalities.

Once all external users and recursive edges redirect to specialized families, original internal function may become dead. Cyclic self-use alone is not external reachability; require whole call graph and address-use accounting.
Cyclic PHI discovery requires bounded iterative exploration across transitive merges; reducing discovery budget intentionally loses opportunities rather than inventing constants.
A strongly connected PHI region can retain a common constant from its external inputs. Acyclic-only local propagation misses this benefit.
Conflicting external PHI inputs must prevent constant collapse; equal jointly specialized arguments can enable it. Compute combined context before evaluating merge benefits.
Cost ranking and clone limits must retain the association between whole ordered argument signatures and selected callsites after sorting; limits0..3 exercise distinct subsets.

Caller-to-callee constants and callee-to-caller return facts enable successive specialization across three rounds. Revisit dependants after changes. LLVM poison for unused returns is not an Ink value rewrite.

Function-valued returns can expose new direct calls across multiple rounds, but enabling/disabling literal specialization changes opportunities. Exact closure/identity and effect semantics are required for Ink; arbitrary address assumptions cannot transfer.
